gaps.g2: Ten parameters stand (the 2026-10-14 ruling, as built on push/vg-p2-fin): om_growth_probe_run(..., int32_t lot_cap) is the tenth; the probe never includes om_internal.h; the script-fixed constant PROBE_LOT_CAP 8192 is passed by the tests and is the value P3 raises OM_LOT_CAP to (om_internal.h:79, 2048 today). Spec :129 gains the tenth parameter.
gaps.g4: The 119 clause as written is a tautology (core at 120 on side 240 cannot reach past cell 239, which is 119 cells away). Replace it: on the centred core at age 150 the farthest east-ray cell with P > 0 is strictly inside the box (reach under 119 cells, so the field never touches the border and the shape test is unclipped); the reach is printed; if it touches the border the writer reports the number to the Architect before changing anything, as for the death step.
gaps.g11: Carry the narrowing. TD-VG-P-1 (scope-narrowed, ages 20 and up asserted; age 10 prints its ratios and asserts nothing; threshold 0.10 untouched) moves to main byte-identical from push/vg-p2-rulings with the Architect's clerk; spec :136 says 'at ages 20 and up (TD-VG-P-1; age 10 printed)'.
gaps.g12: Left-to-right repeated multiplication, ((P * f) * f) * f, cost times, in one shared helper om_field_apply_cost(double v, double f, uint8_t cost) in field_noise.h/field_noise.c (P2's files); the probe calls it and P3's hop calls the same helper, so the parity test compares one arithmetic. No pow.
gaps.g13: One formula everywhere, s = floor_div(tick, 60), negative during pre-growth, no hidden step counter in the sim. The probe's k-th step (k = 1..N) uses s = k - N, so its sequence ends at 0 exactly as pre-growth does for a core of age N (every core's pre-growth ends at tick 0, so a core of age N sees s = -(N-1)..0 whatever max_age is). The parity test (:192) drives the sim at ticks (k - N) * 60 for k = 1..N, the pre-growth ticks, not 60 * k: that tests the path the game uses. Spec :115 and :192 are corrected to say so.
